entries.41ff8d9a641005b7: Water Supply and Drainage Operation Business
entries.46b175cafd7ff69f: A reportable segment that leases office buildings, hangars, factory buildings and similar properties within airports, and the category with the largest revenue from external customers among the 4 reportable segments. The company is in charge of it. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥17,291 million (up 2.3% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥4,006 million (up 18.0%). The securities report says that rental income increased through revisions of the rental terms of existing properties and tenant attraction, which raised revenue. Profit increased despite large-scale repair work, helped by lower depreciation resulting from the impairment loss recorded in the previous fiscal year on rental facilities in the Haneda Airport Icchome district. In this fiscal year, an impairment loss of ¥1,647 million was recorded in this category following a revision of the building removal costs in the Haneda Airport Icchome district. The land, including the sites of the office buildings, hangars and factory buildings, is administrative property under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and the company has received permission to use it from the Civil Aviation Bureau of the ministry; the permission is renewed every 1 to 3 years.
entries.4797a542a3065124: District Heating and Cooling Business (Heat Supply Business)
entries.487b781a364432d8: A shared communications business conducted within Tokyo International Airport. The securities report does not state the content or amount of this business beyond the description of the reportable segment (shared communications business within Tokyo International Airport).
entries.605a3074c3b32034: This reportable segment provides heat supply, water supply and drainage operations, and shared communication services at Tokyo International Airport and New Chitose Airport. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥7,459 million (up 5.3%), and segment profit was ¥1,154 million (up 33.3%). The securities report cites the revision of the basic charge for chilled and hot heat supply in the heat supply business and the increase in water supply and drainage volume in the water supply and drainage business as reasons. The Business and Other Risks section states that Japan Airlines Co., Ltd., All Nippon Airways Co., Ltd. and Japan Airport Terminal Co., Ltd. are the 3 major customers for the heat supply and water supply and drainage businesses.
entries.617ade72415aa27e: A business that operates water supply and drainage at Tokyo International Airport and New Chitose Airport. The related party information states that transaction terms are determined by the water supply and drainage operation unit price at the time of public tender and by the Tokyo International Airport Water Supply and Drainage Usage Regulations. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, an increase in water supply and drainage usage is stated to have increased sales.
entries.6333515dbf341b08: All Nippon Airways Co., Ltd. (a party for which the securities report's information on major customers lists the Out-of-Airport Real Estate Business as the related segment)
entries.788e071fbdd969b5: A business that supplies cooling and heating as district heating and cooling within Tokyo International Airport. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Tokyo Airport Air Conditioning Co., Ltd. (the Company's ownership of voting rights: 60.32%). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, a revision of the basic charges for cooling and heating is stated to have increased sales. Sales volume decreased 2.3% for cooling and 1.5% for heating from the previous fiscal year. Part of the operation management and administration of the heat supply business is entrusted to Shin Nippon Air Technologies Co., Ltd.
entries.78da86afb749d308: Real estate leasing of office buildings, hangars, factory buildings and other facilities
entries.7d2a08d7ad234caf: A reportable segment that leases office buildings, hangars, factory buildings and other facilities located inside airports, and the one with the largest sales to external customers among the 4 reportable segments.
entries.7fd214a10b7dcbc3: A company that leases buildings and hangars at airports such as Haneda Airport, also operates heating, cooling, and water supply and drainage, and earns rent and fees from airlines and airport-related companies.
entries.81ebb900fa4ccb92: Japan Airport Terminal Co., Ltd. (a party for which the securities report's information on major customers lists the In-Airport Real Estate Business as the related segment)
entries.83bad22bf8e1de9a: A reportable segment that includes overseas business (real estate leasing by subsidiaries in Singapore and Canada), lending of funds, movable property leasing, and the solar power generation business. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥729 million (down 6.2% year on year) and segment profit was ¥257 million (down 12.8%). The securities report gives as reasons the transfer of some solar power generation facilities, among others. The overseas business is carried out by AIRPORT FACILITIES ASIA PTE.LTD., AFS PROPERTIES PTE.LTD., AFN PROPERTIES LTD. and AFC Shoji Co., Ltd.

entries.b158f953a4430eca: A reportable segment that supplies heat, operates water supply and drainage, and provides shared communications at Tokyo International Airport and New Chitose Airport.
entries.bac3f218616a18d9: A reportable segment that leases office buildings, apartment buildings, hotels and other facilities located outside airports and sells real estate; it also includes the non-asset business. The Company and AFC Asset Management Co., Ltd. are in charge of it (the Affiliated Companies section prints the relationship with that company as entrustment of real estate property management). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥11,312 million (up 77.5% year on year) and segment profit was ¥2,929 million (up 98.4%). The securities report gives as reasons the sale of 3 office buildings held as real estate for sale in the non-asset business and the full-year operation of an office building acquired in the previous fiscal year. In this fiscal year, the Group also formed its first privately placed real estate fund.
